refused.MAX_ACCOUNTS_PER_EMAIL: reads one past it and refuses the invitation, naming why
refused.MAX_ACTIVE_OPERATIONS_READ: reads one past it and refuses the change until operations finish
refused.MAX_ORGANIZATIONS_PER_PERSON: reads one past it and refuses: Clerk's webhooks write memberships, so no write here can
refused.UNRECORDED_REVISIONS_MAX: reads one past it and throws, naming the migration that records them
refused.COPY_HISTORY_MAX: reads one past it and refuses the copy
refused.DRAFT_ROWS_REPLACED: reads one past it and refuses the restore over a draft with extra rows
refused.SUBSCRIPTIONS_READ: reads one past it and stops the billing migration for that account
refused.SEARCH_SCREENINGS_MOVED: a search with more screenings than a move takes stays where it is, and the dialog says so
refused.SECTION_REGISTRY.length: a draft or revision holds one row a section; reads one past it and throws on a different row
refused.MAX_ORGANIZATION_MEMBERS: reads one past it and leaves the organization's seats as they are, logging why: Clerk's webhooks write memberships, so no write here can

windows.RECENT_CHARGES_READ: a leaver's newest charges, read for one the ledger worker hasn't counted yet; it counts within seconds, so older ones are in the aggregate
windows.PREVIEW_READ: the first ratings of a paper a collection preview reads for the few raters it names; the count and the full list come from elsewhere
windows.JOBS_DOCKED: the few jobs a chat docks at once; older ones are on the jobs page
windows.STEPS_SHOWN: the newest steps a reply shows; the rest are paged in the chat
windows.JOBS_TOLD_AT_ONCE: the job ends one reply tells its model; the rest are told on the next
windows.EACH: the first matches the @ picker shows per kind; typing narrows them
windows.NEWEST_PUBLISHES_READ: the newest publishes a library's status looks at
windows.RUNTIME_ARRIVALS_READ: the newest runtime arrivals the activation looks at
windows.SEARCH_RESULTS_MAX: Convex's full text search returns at most 1,024 results
windows.ASSISTANT_REPLIES_AT_ONCE: the replies a person runs at once, which admission keeps within it
windows.MAX_ASKS: the questions one reply asks at a time; the reply refuses to ask more
windows.MEMBERS_COUNTED: an organization's members are counted up to one past it and shown as more than it
windows.LIBRARIES_COUNTED: a workspace's Evidence Libraries are counted up to one past it in its summary
windows.MEMBERS_MATCHED: the best search matches of an email the invite check compares; an exact email is among the first
windows.INVITATIONS_MATCHED: the invitations waiting for one address that an invite looks through for this organization's; past it Clerk still refuses a duplicate
windows.SINGLE_ROW_CLEANUP: rows meant to be one per key: a duplicate or two a race left are cleared, and more wait for the next write
windows.MAX_API_KEYS_PER_USER: a person has one key per provider, since saving one replaces the provider's, so this many is all of them
windows.MAX_RATERS: the members of an organization its averages read, and the ratings of a paper in one collection; Clerk lets a free organization have 5 members
windows.PLACES_NOTED: the collections a removed or restored paper notes in their Activity; a paper in more is noted in the first of them
windows.MAKER_ROWS_READ: the makers of one kind of record the Run by filter reads for members who left; one row per person who ever made one, so an organization past it lists the first of them
windows.OPEN_HOLDS_READ: the holds a member has open, summed to size a reply's hold under their cap; a job holds one per slot and a workspace has 40 slots, and Autumn enforces the cap whatever this reads
windows.READ_LIBRARIES_MAX: the libraries a person used last, the first ones their roles give, and the newest grants; any other library is reached by its address
windows.SAME_KEY_READ: the first papers of a job that share one identifier; a paper is one of them or none, since more than a few sharing a title are different papers
windows.DOMAIN_CLAIMS_READ: the claims of one host; a host is served for one library, and claimed by a few at most

batches.ACTIVITY_STEP: a moved item's activity rows, a step at a time; it reschedules itself until none are left in the old workspace
batches.BATCH: a worker's batch; it pings itself for the next
batches.BATCH_SIZE: a cascade's batch; it reschedules itself until nothing is left
batches.CANCEL_BATCH: a cancel's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.JOBS_A_STEP: a deleted organization's purge step; it schedules the next until its workspace is empty
batches.FORGET_BATCH: a cleanup's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.FORGET_LIMITS: a cleanup's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.FORGET_RESULTS: a cleanup's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.FORGET_STEPS: a cleanup's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.PURGE_BATCH: a purge's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.SWEEP_BATCH: a sweep's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.MEMBERSHIP_DELETE_BATCH: a collection deletion's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.MEMBERSHIP_REVOKE_BATCH: a revocation's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.PLACES_BATCH: a removal's or restore's batch of places; it reschedules itself
batches.PAPERS_A_PASS: a job deletion's pass; it reschedules itself
batches.SERVED_HOSTS_BATCH: a host sync's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.JOBS_WOKEN: the jobs one dispatch wakes; the next dispatch wakes more
batches.SPENT_PAGE: a hold cleanup's batch; it reschedules itself
batches.FACET_COPY_INLINE: the memberships a paper's change copies inline; more are copied by a scheduled batch
batches.MEMBERSHIPS_INLINE: the memberships a user's change updates inline; more are updated by a scheduled page at a time
batches.FORGET_FILES: a cleanup batch of attached files; it reschedules itself until nothing is left
batches.PURGE_RATINGS: a cleanup batch of a deleted account's ratings; the account waits for the next run until none are left
batches.PURGE_GRANTS: a cleanup batch of a deleted account's places as a guest; the account waits for the next run until none are left
batches.FOLLOW_STEP: a renamed or deleted item's guest rows, a step at a time; it reschedules itself until all are renamed or gone
batches.PURGE_READERS: a purged person's libraries, a step at a time; the cleanup runs again until none are left
batches.DELETE_STEP: a job's library keys, a step at a time; it reschedules itself until none are left
batches.FIXTURE_ROWS: what one test fixture with a made-up paper ID holds, deleted with it by migrations/paperIdentity:narrow; fixtures hold a handful
